title: 10 Best Plantago Major Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Plantago major are teas, decoctions, tinctures, mucillages, and creams, each offering unique therapeutic benefits. Teas made from dried leaves are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions involve boiling the leaves to extract more potent compounds, often used for respiratory or skin conditions. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, ideal for internal use or topical applications. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gel-like substance, are used to ease coughs and promote wound healing. Creams infused with Plantago major are applied externally to treat skin irritations and promote healing.
